name: Hostinger mailbox (work email)
detail: All 37 Sent and 80 Inbox messages scanned. 31 sent messages went to prospect addresses/domains; no inbox message came from a prospect.

name: Gmail (personal)
detail: Sent and inbound mail searched against every prospect domain: 6 sent threads matched (one bounced, noted in its snippet). Inbound hits were vendor mail, not replies.

name: LinkedIn notification emails
detail: 'Accepted your invitation' / message notices matched to prospects by exact full name: 5 accepted, 1 message. Coverage is partial (notices show first names only).

name: LinkedIn API (Composio)
detail: Connected toolkit cannot read conversations, sent invitations or read receipts, so LinkedIn sends/seen are not importable. Log them with the buttons on each contact.

name: Email opens
detail: No open-tracking tool found in either mailbox, so 'Seen' for email can only be logged manually.
